(1) The same-book machinery's first real game (BALANCE_FRAMEWORK 10.118, landmine L54; BACKLOG B, merge-checklist step 5): two checkpoint legs on the canon, each ending at 1855.3.1, off 1 January on purpose, to see which save the harvest keeps when a leg does not end on a yearly autosave; a later schedule continues one of them as a middle leg (1855 -> 1857, checkpoint) to prove the post-build fingerprint check, the observer's continuation arguments and a save the game loads.
